title: The south in 5 days
summary: Ho Chi Minh City plus either Can Tho, Phu Quoc, or Da Lat. Not all three.

days.title: Days 3–4 — One add-on
days.body: A night in Can Tho, a flight to Phu Quoc, or a night bus to Da Lat.

days.title: Day 5 — Back to the airport
days.body: Tan Son Nhat, unless you fly out of the add-on city.

seoDescription: Ho Chi Minh City and one of Can Tho, Phu Quoc, or Da Lat.
